findings.title: The "no description" failure branch's src-naming is never tested
findings.detail: Task 5 requires both of RenderCopilotAgent's failure messages to name src with one error style. internal/hosts/copilot.go:39 (fmt.Errorf("%s: frontmatter has no description", src)) is the second branch — reached when the frontmatter parses but has no/empty description. No test in this diff (internal/hosts/copilot_test.go, internal/prompt/copilot_test.go, internal/tools/hostgen/main_test.go) constructs input that hits this branch at all; TestRenderCopilotAgentRefusesAFileWithoutFrontmatter only feeds unparseable frontmatter (the first branch, prompt.Frontmatter's own error) and only asserts err != nil, never the message text. TestRunNamesTheRealSourcePathUnderARoot (main_test.go:85) also uses "no frontmatter here\n", hitting the same first branch. The description-less branch's src-naming — half of what #14 changed — has zero coverage, so a regression there (e.g. reverting to the old "agents/"+ccName+".md" format) would pass every test.

findings.title: Backslash-run test's boundary case is mislabeled "zero" when the actual run is two
findings.detail: The case named "a run at the very start of the body is even (zero)" uses value `"\\"b"` (body `\\"b`), where the backslash run preceding the quote at body index 2 is 2, not 0 — it exercises the loop's j>=0 boundary (the run extends to the start of body) rather than a zero-length run. The assertion itself is correct (byte 3), so this is a naming/comment nit, not a functional gap — but the parenthetical is confusing for a future maintainer reading it as documentation of what's being pinned.
